svg.title: Calendar board of 212 days of GitHub contributions since May 2026; a mouse walks from the first day to today, stopping on the busiest days.
svg.text: Every day since May, one tile at a time
3,504 contributions across 212 days. Darker tiles are busier days; the mouse stops on the busiest.
